proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Feral Senses is a permanent always-on trait with no activation event, no use count, and no rest reset cadence. The only current ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which structurally requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. Forcing this unit into 'activation' with fabricated resource fields would be dishonest — there is no action, no quota consumed, no charge that tracks uses, and no rest that refills anything. A new family (e.g., 'passive_grant') is needed for class features that take effect permanently at the level they are acquired.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your connection to the forces of nature grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense variant in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive_grant family existed, ClassFeatureEffect only offers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. Blindsight is a special sense — the v4 atom inventory already contains grant_sense (Effect Atoms section), but it is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union type in types.ts. A new variant is needed: { kind: 'grant_sense'; sense: 'blindsight' | 'darkvision' | 'tremorsense' | 'truesight'; rangeFeet: number }.
proposed_widenings.evidence: grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet

notes: Two layered gaps: (1) no passive/permanent-grant family exists in ClassFeatureMechanics — the activation family forces fields (resource, resetCadence) that have no semantic meaning for an always-on trait; (2) even within a hypothetical passive family, ClassFeatureEffect has no grant_sense variant. The v4 taxonomy already names grant_sense as an effect atom, so the atom itself is not new — only the surface type variant and the family shape are missing. Classification is structural_widening because the family gap is the outer blocker.
